identity.one_of_one_hook: Ossuary Dredge reclaims cursed wreckage into temporary cover and protective power using Salvage Charge.
identity.silhouette_read: Heavy asymmetrical hooded undead biped, giant circular bone-rib dredge, opposing jagged timber bulwark, open wreck rigging and cyan lantern.
identity.gameplay_promise: Protect, reclaim, reforge, control and empower; reclaim debris into defenses and displace enemies.
identity.counterplay: Production design pending: fair telegraphs, finite salvage resource, cover destruction and control resistance require explicit design review and real testing.

design.visual_identity: Broad asymmetrical heavy bipedal tank; hooded undead face with dark recess, narrow cyan glow and exposed cyan-lit skeletal ribs; no tentacle beard. Bone-brine plates with ivory curved whale-bone ribs, dark blue-black metal, rusted antique-gold ironwork, chains and bound salvage ropes. Tattered crimson-magenta sails and cloth drape over shoulder and waist; cyan brine lantern and magical energy glow. Ossuary Dredge: large arm-carried cylindrical salvage winch, circular ribbed bone-claw aperture and glowing cyan brine chamber; preserve exact weapon shape, not an anchor-scythe. Opposite arm retains the original strapped jagged timber-and-bone salvage bulwark shown in hero art and turnarounds. Original wreck frame mounted behind shoulders: open shipwreck timber rigging, rope webbing, mast fragments and hanging lantern; do NOT substitute a full galleon. Preserve the owner-approved dark navy/cyan/gold 4:3 board, its exact hood, armor, proportions, five turnaround views, material studies, weapon breakdown and six ability panels.
design.accessibility_notes: Check contrast, gameplay-distance silhouette, VFX obstruction, color-blind readability, sound alternatives and safe flashes in real tests.

active_abilities.name: Dredge Snare
active_abilities.summary: Fires chains and bone-ribs from the Ossuary Dredge to latch onto enemies and wreckage, dragging them toward Dreadhull and displacing their position.

active_abilities.name: Salvage Recall
active_abilities.summary: Pulls floating or shattered debris back into himself, restoring armor and briefly healing for a portion of the reclaimed wreckage.

active_abilities.name: Reforge Bulwark
active_abilities.summary: Converts dredged wreckage into a large bonebrine barricade, granting cover and a protective aura that reduces incoming damage for Dreadhull and nearby allies.

active_abilities.name: Wreckline Drag
active_abilities.summary: Whips a chain line from the dredge, dragging a targeted enemy along with nearby wreckage, briefly slowing them on arrival and disrupting their formation.

active_abilities.name: Graveyard Forge
active_abilities.summary: Dredges a massive field of wreckage from the seafloor, erupting into a fortified salvage zone. The area becomes a graveyard forge that grants cover, empowers allies' defenses, and continuously reclaims debris over time.

passive.name: Sunken Claim
passive.summary: Damage absorbed by his shields stores Salvage Charge. At high charge, his next defensive ability is strengthened (increased shield, duration, and additional effect).
